question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle A=80^\circ\), \(BD\) bisects \(\angle ABC\), and \(CE\) bisects \(\angle ACB\). \(BD\) and \(CE\) intersect at point \(O\). Find the measure of \(\angle BOC\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: \(\angle ABC+\angle ACB=100^\circ\), and \(\angle OBC+\angle OCB=50^\circ\), so \(\angle BOC=180^\circ-50^\circ=130^\circ\).
solutions.title: Triangle angle sums and angle bisectors
